summary.text: Jason Lohmann is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Steven Jacob.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a farmer who serves on the Zumbrota-Mazeppa School Board and other local boards.

paragraphs.text: Lohmann graduated from Zumbrota-Mazeppa High School, and Ballotpedia lists delivery driver among his career experience.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he serves on the Zumbrota-Mazeppa School Board, the Goodhue County Education District Board, the Zumbrota Township Board and the fire board.
He listed full funding for pre-K-12 and special education, rural infrastructure, small farms and businesses, and veterans as his priorities.
He listed endorsements from the MN DFL, the DFL Rural Caucus, AFL-CIO and AFSCME, among others.
